customManagers.description: Bump the PINNED CI gate tools (ruff/mypy/reuse/pytest) that ci.yml installs inside a `pip install` run-step. They are pinned so a linter widening its default rules cannot turn the pipeline red on its own; Renovate keeps them current as reviewable PRs.

packageRules.description: Data-plane image: pin + update by immutable digest. A human MUST merge (never auto-apply to a school's proxy).
